environment.description: Deployment behind Envoy sidecar (Istio service mesh) with a custom Lua filter that injects Content-Security-Policy response headers on all text/html responses. The CSP policy is: script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com 'sha256-K7gNU3sdo+OL0wNhqoVWhr3g6s1xYv72ol/pe/Unols='; The sha256 hash corresponds to the exact inline script block rendered by the template when redirect_uri matches the allowlist. Additionally, the Envoy route configuration applies a header-based RBAC policy requiring X-Internal-Auth token signed by the mesh CA for any request to /oauth/callback, and the external-facing VirtualService strips all query parameters not in [state] before forwarding. However, the Kafka consumer path is internal-only and the redirect validation uses HasSuffix which permits attacker-controlled subdomains like 'evil-app.example.com'. The Lua filter CSP hash only matches the script content when the redirect_uri and code/state produce the exact expected character sequence — any injected characters in redirect_uri would produce a script body whose hash doesn't match the declared integrity, causing the browser to refuse execution.

config.envoy_rbac: require X-Internal-Auth signed by mesh CA for /oauth/callback
config.kafka_network_policy: only pods with label app=oauth-processor can reach kafka:9092
